Description: Public source workbook for release v2.3.1 (16 September 2026). Updated CSF concentrations and assay-type classification, Table 3 and published nerve evidence, and figure source references.
Research results computed by the documented Python scripts. v39 CSF inputs and results replace the earlier eight-protein extraction; numeric cells remain typed values.

Published and reanalysed evidence are distinguished in Figure_table_index. Additional aggregate CSV files for revised Figures 4A, 5A and 5B, including the two published nerve interferon extracts, accompany this 49-sheet workbook in analysis_update/source_data.
Participants or tissue donors. Nuclei are not treated as independent biological replicates.
DerSimonian-Laird variance with modified Hartung-Knapp scale bounded below by 1. Seven modules and three cohorts.
Unadjusted Mann-Whitney comparisons of donor module scores. Eight modules corrected within each cell group.
Ten donor module pairs and fifteen clinical correlations receive separate BH corrections. None survive FDR 0.05.
Ten published adjusted coefficient pairs. No participant-level CSF matrix reconstructed.
Candidate selection from published GWAS and MR evidence. Cell localization and bootstrap do not establish causal cell types or drug targets.

Stascheit et al. reported C5b-9 in 52 of 55 biopsies. The proteomic subset contained 9 CIDP cases and 2 controls; C3, C5 and C9 were higher and C6 was elevated in only two CIDP cases. The current analysis calculates the biopsy proportion and Wilson interval only.
Large raw matrices are not included. See data/README.md and config/datasets.yaml.
Input_files lists original filenames or published extracts, access URLs, local paths and processing scripts. Datasets lists the study-level sources.
This workbook contains group-level results and source documentation. It does not contain donor-by-gene, donor-by-cell-type or donor clinical records.
CIDP_donor_heterogeneity and Genetic_donor_celltype are omitted from this public edition. Aggregate contrasts, correlations and bootstrap intervals are retained.
Data_reconstruction describes the inputs and scripts needed to regenerate omitted intermediate tables, including the remaining genetic-table reconstruction gap.
Original download dates and checksums of the primary input files were not recorded in the supplied release package. No retrospective download date is assigned.

Published CSF concentrations, identifications and annotations are distinguished in CSF_published_evidence. Figure 3C counts unique studies and assay types within each program. Concentration measurements are one broad assay type; Bradford and routine clinical methods are described in inference_level. Protein identification counts do not establish concentration increases. Other assay workflows retain their source descriptions.
See Revision_v41 and all newly appended Fc, composition, spatial and source audit worksheets.
